news.title: 'I killed him': Suspect accused of killing man he believed was sleeping with his wife at Doraville restaurant
news.summary: Officers stopped the truck and detained Roman-Cortez. During the encounter, he reportedly told officers, “I shot him, I killed him.”

news.title: Deadly shooting involving Atlanta officer stems from warrant, attempted ramming, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are responding to a shooting involving one of its officers. Police said the deadly shooting happened when a suspect fled a warrant.

news.title: Driver shot, killed by Atlanta police after ramming patrol car, APD says
news.summary: Atlanta police officers shot and killed a driver Thursday evening after a car rammed a patrol cruiser as officers tried to arrest a wanted suspect in northwest Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Man arrested after 100-plus gather to watch burnouts near apartment complex
news.summary: Some Kennesaw State University students are frustrated by drivers doing burnouts in a parking lot.

news.title: Suspect arrested after deadly shooting at McDonough apartments
news.summary: A man is dead, and a suspect is in custody following a fatal shooting Wednesday afternoon at an apartment complex in McDonough, according to police.

news.title: Warrants reveal new details after 4-year-old found dead in SW Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police have arrested a second woman on murder charges as arrest warrants reveal new disturbing details in the death of 4-year-old Colby Cooks.

news.title: Warrant details strange, deadly dispute behind Clayton County murder arrest
news.summary: Investigators said the suspect got into a verbal altercation with 25-year-old Delrico Beebe inside a store after Beebe complained about Colbert passing gas.

news.title: Gwinnett judge allowing murder defendant take kids trick-or-treating
news.summary: A Gwinnett County judge is permitting a mother charged in the death of her 16-month-old son to trick-or-treat with her children inside her transitional housing complex.

news.title: DA: Mother's boyfriend sentenced after pleading guilty to sexually assaulting 10-month-old girl in Paulding County
news.summary: The DA said Jesse James Hawkins, 22, was arrested after investigators determined that he had sexually assaulted the 10-month-old with an unknown object.

news.title: Warrant: Suspects in the Cherokee County school shooting plot were planning almost a year in advance, and had a floor plan of the school
news.summary: The Canton Police Department announced arrests earlier this week of 17-year-old Shane Taylor, 21-year-old Michael Terry and an unnamed third juvenile defendant.
